map.n 与 r 必须同单位：按月收款就填月利率，按年收款就填年利率。36 期配月利率: n and r must use the same units: fill in the monthly rate for monthly payments and the annual rate for annual payments. 36 periods at a monthly rate of 1% is a 3 year term; mistakenly using an annual rate of 1% (a true annual rate of about 12%) would significantly underestimate the present value.

map.是。同一组现金流，终值是未来值、现值是当前值，互为 (1+i)^n 关系。: Yes. For the same series of cash flows, the future value is the value in the future and the present value is the value now, related by a factor of (1 + i)^n.
